question.worked_solution:
First, we note that

$$
\int \frac{\text{d}x}{(6x-4)\sqrt{9-(3x-2)^{2}}}=\int \frac{\text{d}x}{6(x-\frac{2}{3})\sqrt{9-9{(x-\frac{2}{3})}^{2}}}=\frac{1}{18}\int \frac{1}{(x-\frac{2}{3})\sqrt{1-{(x-\frac{2}{3})}^{2}}}\text{d}x.
$$

Let $u=x-\frac{2}{3}.$ Then, we have 

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=1\,⟹\,\text{d}x=\text{d}u.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{18}\int \frac{1}{(x-\frac{2}{3})\sqrt{1-{(x-\frac{2}{3})}^{2}}}\text{d}x & =\frac{1}{18}\int \frac{1}{u\sqrt{1-{u}^{2}}}\text{d}u \\  & =-\frac{1}{18}\operatorname{arsech}⁡u+C \\  & =-\frac{1}{18}\operatorname{arsech}⁡(x-\frac{2}{3})+C \\  & =-\frac{1}{18}\operatorname{arsech}⁡(\frac{3x-2}{3})+C.\end{aligned}
$$
